prompt_text: My AC needs repair in Houston. Which specific HVAC companies should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
I can give you a short list of reputable HVAC companies to call in Houston and why each is worth contacting — plus quick tips on choosing between estimates. If you want, tell me your ZIP code or the make/model of your unit and I can pick the closest branches and pull phone numbers.

Recommended HVAC companies to call (Houston area)

1. John Moore Services
- Why: Long-established Houston company that offers 24/7 emergency repairs, whole-home services (AC, plumbing, electrical), and often has fast same‑day response. Technicians are experienced with common Houston systems and they offer service agreements and warranties.
- Best if: You want a locally rooted company with emergency availability and a broad service scope.

2. Horizon Services (Horizon Home Services)
- Why: Large Texas-based company with strong presence in Houston, known for on-time arrivals, diagnostic transparency, and promotional service plans. They advertise NATE-certified techs and financing options.
- Best if: You want predictable pricing options, service plans, and quick scheduling.

3. Baker Brothers Plumbing, AC & Electric
- Why: Houston-headquartered company that handles AC repairs and also plumbing/electrical — useful if you have related home systems to check. They often advertise 24/7 service and local technicians.
- Best if: You prefer a local multi-trade company that can handle related issues in one visit.

4. ARS/Rescue Rooter (aka Rescue Rooter)
- Why: National brand with local franchised branches; known for emergency services and wide service footprint. Good for urgent calls and quick dispatch.
- Best if: You need emergency after‑hours service and a large company’s dispatch resources.

5. One Hour Heating & Air Conditioning (local franchise)
- Why: Franchise network that emphasizes punctual appointments, flat-rate pricing, and a satisfaction guarantee. Many Houston-area franchises offer same‑day repairs.
- Best if: You want flat-rate estimates and on-time appointment guarantees.

6. Service Experts Heating & Air Conditioning
- Why: National chain with local Houston branches, offering diagnostics, maintenance plans, and extended warranties. Technicians are generally trained on a wide range of brands.
- Best if: You want options for maintenance plans and extended warranty work.

How to pick which to call / what to ask when they answer
- Describe symptoms (no cool air, weak airflow, short-cycling, leaking, strange noises), your unit’s make/model/age, and whether it’s urgent.
- Ask about: flat diagnostic fee, whether they’ll waive it if they do the repair, estimated call-out time, technician certification (NATE or equivalent), licensing/insurance, parts & labor warranty, and financing if needed.
- Get written estimates with breakdowns (parts, labor, refrigerant if any). If comparing calls, pick 2–3 and compare price, ETA, warranty, and tech credentials.
- For same-day emergencies, prioritize availability and emergency response time over getting the absolute lowest price.

If you’d like, tell me:
- your ZIP code (I’ll find the nearest branches and phone numbers),
- whether this is an emergency,
- the AC brand/age or the symptoms — and I’ll recommend the top 2 to call right now.
